interpretation: Before-date LVNL geometry and later primary AIP geometry agree exactly for runway 18R coordinates and true axis. A near-date 16 March 2023 report independently corroborates the 270 m displacement. This is sufficient supporting evidence for the mock exercise, while retaining the exact-cycle limitation.
limitations: The exact AIP cycle effective on 15 March 2023 and historical NOTAMs have not been retrieved; temporary threshold changes are not independently ruled out.
Attempts to read historical LVNL 2023 cycle URLs failed. Agreement of before/after sources is supporting evidence, not proof that no intermediate changes occurred.
The ADS-B export has no lastposupdate field. Geometry verification does not establish position freshness or exact subsecond threshold crossing time.
Elevation values vary slightly between publications. ADS-B altitude should not be treated as calibrated height above this threshold without pressure/altitude datum handling.
